conflict_resolutions.NO_ORDER_CITED_IN_CURRENT_LAW: The two leads are 33 U.S.C. 1267 note entries that print EO 13508 as a statutory note (U.S. Code release point current through 2026-10-09). A note that prints an order's text records the order and does not keep it in force; EO 14428 was signed on September 16, 2026 and published on September 21, 2026, and its section 2 revokes EO 13508. The note's silence about the revocation reflects an edition that predates the order's codification update, not a continuing predicate.

research_rationale:
EO 13508 of May 12, 2009 set up Chesapeake Bay restoration duties for the Federal Leadership Committee and agencies, many with dated deadlines (reports and strategies) that are performance dates and not ends.
